## Description

Fix the confirmed findings that are not Azure wiring. (a) `patients.DataKeys`: REVOKE DELETE for the module role and allow UPDATE only through the re-wrap path; `TenantKeyRing.Get` must throw, not silently create a new key, when the tenant already has encrypted identifier rows but no key row (otherwise a deleted key row makes every identifier unreadable). (b) `medvya_reporting` gets per-table SELECT on `tenancy` (or masked views for Invitations, DoctorLicences, Profiles, SettingsChanges) instead of SELECT on all tables. (c) Ledger hash: hash an explicit column list stored per table in `ledger.Tables`, not `to_jsonb(row)`, so adding a column later does not break every old chain; a test adds a column and verifies the chain still passes. (d) Exempt tables (`ledger.Tables`, `ledger.Chains`, `TenantIndex`, `OutboxTenants`): revoke DELETE, insert into `ledger.Tables` only from migrations, and have the ledger functions ignore unknown table names. (e) Gate the destructive national-ID migration with a data-present check that fails loudly outside an empty database. (f) Document in database-security.md that the tenant and user settings are user-settable and who may hold app or reporting logins (accepted limit, for the external review). (g) Bind each ciphertext to its row (add the row id to the associated data) or record why not.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a module role, when it tries to DELETE a DataKeys row, then the database refuses it.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a tenant with identifier rows and no key row, when the key is requested, then the call throws and no new key is created.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the reporting role, when it reads Invitations, DoctorLicences or Profiles, then it is refused or sees only masked columns.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a column is added to a ledger table, when verify_chain runs, then every old chain still verifies.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given an app role, when it deletes from ledger.Chains or TenantIndex, then the database refuses it.
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a database that already holds identifier rows, when the national-ID migration runs, then it stops with a clear error instead of dropping data.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
